evidence: In the heart of Ha Dong District, nestled amidst the bustling life of a thousand-year-old weaving village, lies the Van Phuc Silk Craft Founder Temple, a serene and sacred sanctuary that embodies the essence of the imperial land. This revered temple, dedicated to the memory of Thành hoàng A Lã Thị Nương, a talented and virtuous woman, is a testament to the enduring legacy of the craft village.
